prose.description: The warrior caste of the Hive, with a heavily armored head that shrugs off blows that would kill a human. Soldier Drones fight without fear for their Queen. Cut off from the Hive, they keep the skills of a fighter but lose the sense of purpose that the Queen gave them.
prose.speech: Short, plain sentences about the task at hand. Without a Hive they can sound lost or eager for orders.
